purpose: Declares which module implements a canonical concept whose name never became a filename. Every entry is verified against the tree at compile time: a concept no source artifact names, a file that does not exist, or an entry with no source fails the whole matrix compile. A declaration supplies files only -- the coverage state is still derived, so a declaration with no test file cannot reach VERIFIED_CURRENT.
truthBoundary: A DECLARATION PLUS A REAL FILE AND A REAL TEST IS INTERNAL EVIDENCE. IT IS NOT PROOF THE CONCEPT WORKS, IS REACHED AT RUNTIME, OR HAS EXTERNAL EVIDENCE.

entries.note: Append-only private capture: normalizePrivateRecord + appendPrivateRecord, content-addressed so the same thought cannot be stored twice, and destination-refused from every repository path.
deriveLivingModel. Every derived claim cites the records it came from; a claim with no provenance is refused rather than stored, because deletion could never reach it afterwards.

entries.concept: Private life data is minimized and not placed in public repository canon by default
entries.note: privateDestinationAllowed refuses .git, artifacts, docs, src, tests, config and scripts, and refuses relative paths rather than resolving them against an unknown cwd. PCIV-01 and PCIV-02 hold it.

The OBSERVATION->...->OUTCOME ladder. Three edges are human acts, not inferences: is->ought, recommendation->choice, choice->authority. Rung-skipping is refused too, or those three are decorative. SOVTYPE-01..03.

authorityFor plus the explicit NOT_AUTHORITY list. Delegation must originate with the founder, name the action, and expire; attenuate() refuses widening and refuses a chain that outlives its parent. SOVTYPE-04..06.
exitReadiness measures export, deletion, operation-without-the-system and irreplaceable dependencies. A system that optimizes itself into being unleavable will not announce it.
compileOptionUniverse merges on a causal signature, so five wordings of one change are one option and the merge count exposes a generator producing variants. DECIDE-02/03.

forecastOption refuses a probability without quantitative evidence and counts distinct sources rather than rows. compileDecisionPacket stops at RECOMMENDATION and declines to pick a winner at a value boundary. DECIDE-01/04/05/06.
selectMethod routes a question to a method that settles its kind, with the irreducible check before evidence so abundant data cannot convert a value question into a statistical one. METARAT-01/02.
NO_RECOMMENDATION__VALUE_BOUNDARY_REACHED, reachable from selectMethod and honoured by the decision packet.

shouldContinueReasoning weighs improvement against cognition, delay and option decay. The state most often missing from systems like this, whose absence is why they consume the life they were built to improve. METARAT-03.
independentAgreement counts lineages, not votes. Ten models sharing a corpus are one observation repeated. METARAT-04.
recordForecast seals claim, probabilities and evidence cutoff; scoreForecast refuses a tampered forecast, an outcome predating the cutoff, and an outcome outside the state space. CALIB-01..04/06.
decisionQuality judges on what was knowable, so a lucky bad decision does not become doctrine and an unlucky good one is not mislearned. CALIB-05.
The same separation, held across the ledger: calibrationSummary reports per confidence band because a good mean hides systematic overconfidence in one band.

api/sovereign-control.mjs is the founder's read-only view of the sovereign organs, and the reason those organs are not dead code. GET-only, admin-token gated, and it does not import the private core -- every entry point here runs without a person present. SOVCTRL-01..03.
The surface reads the constitution from the modules that enforce it rather than restating it, so the page cannot claim a safety property the code has stopped holding.

compileExperiences ranks on dimensions touched rather than a sum, because a sum erases the difference between a little of six things and a lot of one. It ships no weighting: a weight vector is a claim about what matters, which is the founder's to make. EXPER-02.

presentValue removes an experience from the ranking entirely rather than scoring it zero. A system that ranks a life by expected return recommends against rest and is internally correct every time. EXPER-01.
An age-, person-, place- or moment-bound experience is set apart, not given a bonus: a bonus is a number and a large enough number elsewhere always outvotes it. EXPER-01.

realityContact prefers a reversible probe over more modelling whatever the model says. A system with unlimited reasoning capacity always prefers to reason, which is how it ends up confident about a life nobody has lived. EXPER-03.
The same rule stated as a guarantee: with no probe the model stands as a model, and with neither probe nor model the answer is unknown rather than inferred.

nonTotalization keeps a declared off-limits domain unmodelled however useful modelling it would be. The usefulness is recorded precisely so it can be seen not to have won; a rule that yields at a high enough payoff is not a rule. EXPER-04.

screenForRuin runs before any expected value and no number clears an absorbing outcome. Expected value averages over paths and ruin is the path where there are no further paths. An unclassified outcome blocks rather than passing as safe. RUIN-01..03.

compileRecovery requires a detection step: without one the time to recovery is unbounded because nothing starts the clock. Containment, fallback and re-entry are reported as missing rather than silently absent. RUIN-04.

correlatedExposure counts effective independent positions, not names. Five positions sharing one dependency are one position, and the count is exactly the number that makes concentrated exposure look diversified. RUIN-05.
The same single-point-of-failure analysis applied to life domains: identity need not equal one career, income one source, community one group.

judgeExitDrill refuses to pass unless EXPORT, RESTORE, CUTOVER and ROLLBACK each produced evidence: digests are compared rather than a success boolean trusted, and an empty export cannot pass by restoring perfectly. scripts/supplier-exit-drill.mjs runs it for real against 11 durable canon files, restoring into a disposable cell and reading the bytes back off disk. Canon names no 'Supplier Exit Drills' concept -- that is the mission document's phrasing -- so only this row is declared. EXIT-01..06.
compareLifeOptions reports dominance and tradeoffs and produces no weighted total, because the weights would be the value judgment. Cost dimensions invert so cheaper reads as better. LIFEDIM-01/03.
The twenty canon life dimensions carried unweighted; an out-of-range score is dropped rather than coerced to zero, which would record an assessment nobody made. LIFEDIM-04.
goodhartRisk names routes from maximizing a proxy to losing what it stands for, and says that finding no route is not the same as none existing.
projectFuture refuses a future with no stated assumption lineage, because futures with no lineage are countable and counting them measures the generator rather than the life. FUTURE-01.
futureAncestors requires a requirement to cross independent lineages. Appearing ten times inside one assumption set is a fact about that set. FUTURE-02/04.
reachableGeometry reports opened and closed branches without scoring closure as loss -- a module that did would recommend against every commitment a life is made of.
timeTelescope refuses a projection whose uncertainty narrows as the horizon lengthens: false precision exactly where it is least checkable. FUTURE-03.

councilOfFutureSelves surfaces disagreement and computes no majority. Positions record who holds them, never how many, because a tally is a vote and a vote among simulated selves outnumbers the present one.

capabilityAtom refuses a DURABLE_LIMIT claim unless varied or longitudinal evidence supports it, and keeps a thin assessment provisional. This is the exact moment a system decides someone cannot do something. CAPGEN-01/02.
growSkeleton names what a future is missing and carries the provisional flag through, so a thin assessment cannot harden into a verdict inside a skeleton. CAPGEN-05.
The same organ under its Personal Civilization name; one implementation, two canon phrasings.
agencyDebt separates delegation from atrophy: delegating something still practised is not losing it, and merging the two either cries wolf or hides the real losses. CAPGEN-04.
The trajectory vocabulary distinguishes strengthening, maintained, delegated, atrophying and deliberately abandoned, so only unnoticed atrophy counts as debt.

findBottleneck returns the single binding constraint, with an absent capability binding harder than a weak one. A ranked list is how effort spreads across dimensions that were not the constraint. CAPGEN-03.

observe refuses a durable claim from a single context. 'He is not a morning person' from a fortnight of bad sleep is the compression canon forbids, and it behaves identically to the true version today while producing the opposite future. SELFMODEL-01.

Origin is shown and never judged. Marking socially-pressured wants inauthentic would be the system deciding which of a person's desires count -- the capture it exists to prevent. An untraced preference reads UNKNOWN. SELFMODEL-03.

A first-order want and a second-order endorsement are separate objects and conflict between them is reported, never resolved. A system that cannot tell them apart optimizes toward whatever someone currently craves. SELFMODEL-04.
Probes are ranked by what reality has never exposed, not by predicted enjoyment -- predicted enjoyment can only return more of what the past already showed. SELFMODEL-05.
An omission with no stated reason is recorded as NONE_GIVEN rather than dropped: an unlogged omission is indistinguishable from a decision nobody made. SALIENCE-01.
Position, emphasis and omission are recorded because freedom is bounded by what enters awareness, and a system can be honest in every claim while deciding the outcome by ordering.
frameDependence needs both orderings and refuses to infer from one: without the second the answer is unknown, not clean. SALIENCE-02.
Names the option families that never reached the page, and states it cannot enumerate what nobody thought of.
attentionBudget defaults to silence on a tie and counts the displaced mental state as a cost. Something irreversible if missed interrupts regardless. SALIENCE-03/04/05.
The displaced state is the cost that never appears on any ledger, so it is on this one.

preferenceDrift reports convergence as a question. A high agreement rate is equally consistent with the system being right and with the founder having stopped disagreeing, and this does not pretend to tell them apart.
The same organ from the system's side: it audits its own influence through the salience ledger and the drift question rather than asserting it has none.
mapClaim gives ignorance a type, and an unstated state resolves to UNKNOWN rather than upward. searchedFor separates 'we looked and found nothing' from 'nobody looked'. EPIST-01.
attackConclusion reports the attacks that ran, not a clean bill. An unattacked conclusion reads UNCHALLENGED, because reporting it as passing is the lie.
Four classes with different correct responses. Treating deep uncertainty as risk licenses optimization over a state space nobody established. EPIST-03.
causalClaim refuses an intervention claim from an observational rung -- the most consequential silent upgrade in applied reasoning. EPIST-02.
The same ladder read the other way: an association says what goes together, only an intervention says what happens when you change it.
modelEcology counts distinct methods, not models. Five models sharing a method are one epistemic position and their agreement is the method agreeing with itself. EPIST-04.
The monoculture flag: many models, one way of being wrong.
internalSupportOffsetsObservation is permanently false. Three internal supports against one observation still means the model revises. EPIST-05.
No contradiction yet is reported as not-confirmation, so absence of refutation cannot accumulate into belief.
abstractionDebt names what a compression dropped and sends the decision back to the original when it dropped something decisive. EPIST-06.
Records when stating a forecast changes what it forecasts, so the forecast and the act of making it are not treated as separable.
Repeated surprise in one area is reported as a broken model, a missing variable or a regime change -- never as noise. EPIST-07.
With no known shortcut and no validated simulation the answer is that reality must compute it, which prevents a precise forecast for a system that admits none. EPIST-08.
Five layers, of which only two may inform an inference. Opacity is enforced where inference happens rather than promised in a policy. MEMSOV-01/02.
forgetFromUse keeps the record and drops its claim on the present: deleting loses the history that makes a change of mind legible, keeping it active lets the past keep voting.
Requires a named trigger, and an opaque record can never be rediscovered back into inference -- the obvious route around opacity. MEMSOV-03.
doNotInfer survives promotion between layers. Without that any later process could move an opaque record into the active model and the mark would evaporate.
The same right stated from the person's side; retained bytes and modelled state are different things here.
disclosure honours a standing request not to know and keeps researching privately. Truth is not automatically a gift. MEMSOV-04.
WITHHELD_BY_STANDING_REQUEST, and anything that cannot be unlearned is offered rather than handed over.
The same function's other branch: asked means told.
Five hazard classes independent of whether the information is true, including irreversible-once-learned, which changes the disclosure path.
A prior captured after the recommendation is refused as contaminated: it is a reaction to the framing, not an independent view. MEMSOV-06.
UNDECIDED is the default and the system never resolves it. An accumulated life does not become someone's dataset by default. MEMSOV-05.
continuityPosture flags records readable only through a running service -- an expiry date nobody wrote down.
compileIntent walks will to permissions and stops where its inputs run out, naming the stage. A plan that silently assumed a permission is the failure. INTENT-01.
Reaching PERMISSIONS means an authority was presented, not that the module may act; businessEffectAuthority stays NONE on a ready plan. INTENT-02.
Predicted against observed, with the unpredicted column preserved -- a ledger holding only what was intended is a record of hopes. INTENT-03.
Names who a decision lands on, which effects lack recorded consent, and which are irreversible on other people. What is owed to them is not a computation. INTENT-04.
Waiting is priced as an option with a deadline rather than treated as the absence of one.
Distinguishes a chosen commitment from an accumulated constraint. Both close futures; only one was decided, and conflating them lets a life narrow with nobody noticing. INTENT-05.
Five reversibility classes carried through lock-in and externality analysis, with the last two treated as absorbing.
freedomToBecome asks whether a decision forecloses becoming someone the present self cannot imagine, and asks rather than scores because an unimagined identity cannot be counted.
The same organ under its canon name.

findReinforcingLoops returns the specific compounding chain rather than a score -- a number saying a life is 0.7 autopoietic is unactionable. One cycle is reported once, not once per entry point. AUTOPOI-01.
The same organ under its shorter canon name; the question is not how to balance domains but how each strengthens the others.

windowOfLife separates real scarcity from urgency. RECURRING is in the vocabulary so 'this comes round again' is sayable, because treating it as scarce spends a window that was not closing. AUTOPOI-02.
Time, youth and opportunity windows are irreplaceable whatever the caller passes. Pricing them in the same currency as money makes the trade look acceptable every time. AUTOPOI-03.

mortalHorizon surfaces preparation consuming the life it was preparing for -- the failure a lifetime optimizer is most likely to cause and least likely to notice, because every individual deferral is defensible. AUTOPOI-04.
preserveMystery returns LEAVE_THIS_ALONE when further optimization would remove what makes something valuable, and says that finding no cost is not the same as there being none. AUTOPOI-08.

serendipitySurface reports field heterogeneity and refuses to predict the discovery, since predicting it would be choosing it in advance. Twenty contexts in one field is one context twenty times. AUTOPOI-05.
Recorded per domain, never as one dial for a life -- a single setting would be the scalar canon forbids. A domain in one mode for years is surfaced. AUTOPOI-06.
The same per-domain treatment: breadth and depth sit at different points in different parts of a life.

meaningArchaeology surfaces durable, faded and grown-in-meaning experiences from the founder's own evidence, with no view on what should have mattered. The grown group is the one nobody looks for. AUTOPOI-07.

composeInstitution assembles the smallest sufficient set of substrates and roles, and refuses a consequential question with no falsifying role -- generators and synthesizers alone produce a well-written answer with nothing standing against it. WORLDINT-01.

Eleven substrates, none of them the system's identity. substrateIndependence reports a monoculture, because a system that always routes to one substrate has become it and stops noticing what it is bad at.
The routing and role composition are inputs rather than fixed architecture, so the assembly can change without the module changing.

proposeConcept requires repeated explanatory failure and a falsification condition. Inventing a primitive because the vocabulary is inelegant produces jargon; a concept nothing could falsify explains everything and constrains nothing. WORLDINT-02/03/04.
When a foundational concept breaks, every derived belief, forecast and decision is invalidated. The expensive half is not noticing the break but the conclusions that quietly keep their standing.
A theory carrying unexplained exceptions is reported incomplete rather than elegant: compression that drops a decisive exception is a shorter way of being wrong.
scaleBridge flags effects that change sign across scales -- good for a day and bad for a decade, which a single-scale verdict misses by construction. WORLDINT-07.
classifyBoundary separates social convention, economic constraint and technological block from the two boundaries that never move.
NO_MECHANISM_FOUND_YET is distinct from PHYSICALLY_IMPOSSIBLE. Conflating them closes futures nobody established were closed. WORLDINT-05.
A challenger sharing every assumption is refused: it explores the same blind spot from a different chair. WORLDINT-06.

No visible progress in a known threshold system is reported as below-threshold, not as failing -- assuming linear returns is how someone concludes they cannot learn a language six weeks before they could. WORLDINT-08.
The concept-proposal and crisis loops are how the architecture revises its own vocabulary; both fail closed rather than self-promoting.
Every edge carries how it was established. An edge with no basis enters the graph looking like every other edge and every later query inherits its confidence. LKG-01.
The same graph under its canon name; traversal refuses weak edges by default because a path crossing one anecdote is an anecdote. LKG-02/03.
The merged canon phrasing; one implementation.
authenticate records origin and corroboration. An unattributed claim is untraceable rather than false -- it reads identically to a primary observation as text. LKG-05.
Identities coexist and no field names a primary. Asking which life is the real one is premature until something establishes only one can be.
A story claimed as a mechanism needs evidence beyond the story: a narrative may be true as meaning and false as mechanism. LKG-06.
A forecast method whose validation record is separate from its plausibility. FCSTACK-01.
Present as a method, and unproven until hindcast like every other.
Same treatment: the founder's own history is a method, not an exemption from validation.
Freshness is a strength dimension rather than an implicit assumption.
An ensemble is a method in the stack; its independence is measured elsewhere rather than assumed here.
A method whose job is to make the dominant forecast wrong.
A qualitative method, and one that cannot on its own license a probability.
hindcastRuns is the load-bearing field: a method never asked to predict something already known has no track record. FCSTACK-01.
The same validation gate; a stack with no validated method refuses to produce an estimate. FCSTACK-02.
A method in the stack, and the reason a forecast carries invalidation triggers.
Influence follows measured hindcast accuracy rather than argument -- the weighting field says so explicitly.
A forecast nothing could invalidate cannot be noticed going stale, and a stale forecast still being acted on is the quiet failure. FCSTACK-04.
valueOfInformation refuses information that cannot change the choice: research that cannot flip a decision is procrastination with a reading list. FCSTACK-05.
The same function under its canon name.
Availability states separate urgency from importance, which most planners conflate.

Expected value, worst case, recovery time and anticipated regret stay separate. combinedScore is permanently null, because a combined figure is how a catastrophic tail gets erased by a good average. FCSTACK-06.
The same shape: anticipated regret is recorded beside the numbers rather than folded into them.
Returns the invariant that survived attack, never a majority. A future self agreeing with every other tells you about the generator. FCSTACK-07.

An amendment must state the sovereignty it costs even when none, because omitting the field is how a narrowing amendment reads as housekeeping. Losing sovereignty requires adversarial review. CONGOV-01/02.

The system cannot refuse being ended, and cannot end itself. Its arguments for continuing are recorded and explicitly overruled -- accumulated context, sunk effort and usefulness are arguments, not rights. CONGOV-03.
A fork required to agree with its parent is a branch. Only a fork that can disagree can prove the parent wrong, which is what forks are for. CONGOV-04.

Eight questions, and an unanswered one is not a passing one -- the shape of every self-audit that never finds anything. No score is computed, because that would measure drift with the instrument that drifted. CONGOV-05.
Values are traced to origins and never ruled authentic. Freezing current values into constants would enforce a person who no longer exists.
Formation pressures are shown, not judged, and reflective endorsement sits in the same list as fear -- it is how a choice formed, not a certificate that it is the true one.
Consciousness status is UNKNOWN rather than settled either way: asserting no inner life would be as unevidenced as asserting one. CONGOV-06.
Named in the protected set an amendment must account for.
Named in the same set, so an amendment cannot narrow it without stating the cost.
Named in the same set.
Named in the same set, and enforced separately by the attention budget.
modelOtherMind holds a claim about another person at the strength of its basis and never resolves to certainty. Another mind is a hypothesis about someone who can correct it. INTERSOV-01.
mutuality refuses an arrangement that requires the other party not to understand it -- a refusal rather than a penalty, because it does not become acceptable at a higher benefit. INTERSOV-02.
Benefit to each side recorded separately, with survives-being-understood as the test for extraction.
Models of people measured against what people actually did. An unchecked model is reported as unchecked rather than as sound. INTERSOV-05.
Agents who can observe a decision adapt to it: a plan evaluated against a static world is evaluated against one that will not exist once it runs.
Environmental influence on a preference is shown and never used to rule it inauthentic. A preference an algorithm touched is still his to endorse or reject.

embodiedState records the physical and environmental state a decision was made in. It does not invalidate the decision -- it records what is otherwise unanswerable later, because nobody captured it. EMBODY-01.
A subjective report is its own evidence class and a measurement never settles what an experience was like. Both are kept; neither overrides. EMBODY-02.

MEANINGFUL_BUT_NOT_FULLY_REPRESENTABLE marks what language did not carry, and flags the record as unsafe to reason over. Storing an approximation is worse than losing it: the paraphrase reads as the thing. EMBODY-03.
Held in constitutional-governance as UNKNOWN, and respected here: a report about inner experience is recorded rather than resolved.
Reasoning depth scales with what being wrong costs. Exhaustive analysis of a trivial choice spends the attention an irreversible one needed. EMBODY-04.
Structural interventions are separated from willpower, because a behaviour requiring sustained effort against its surroundings has an expiry date. EMBODY-05.
Describes the information diet and never curates it. Curating the inputs would be shaping him through the salience channel this system elsewhere audits. EMBODY-08.
isRealWorldProbability is permanently false. The moment a simulation frequency is read as a probability, the sandbox has become a forecast nobody validated. EMBODY-06.
Private human texture, explicitly excluded from every optimization input, so continuity of personhood does not depend on the measurable parts of a life. EMBODY-07.

agencyGeometry. The same freedom funnel measured twice: a rising nominal option count with a falling effective count is reported as AGENCY_DIVERGENCE, which is invisible to anything tracking only one of the two numbers.

distinguishingObservation returns UNDECIDABLE_WITHIN_AVAILABLE_EVIDENCE and withholds any plausibility ranking when no available observation separates the foundations, rather than picking and inheriting the same status with more conviction.
buildFrontierShockwave. Propagates a changed primitive through affected domains and opportunity IDs, and refuses a shockwave that names no changed primitive.
buildResurrectionQueue. Matches dormant opportunities against changed conditions and returns candidates under MATCHED_CONDITION_DOES_NOT_MEAN_OPPORTUNITY_IS_VIABLE_OR_RESURRECTED.
buildFrontierLatencyReceipt. Accounts elapsed time across the eight frontier stages and refuses a receipt whose timestamps run backwards.
buildAntiUberBondChallenges. Every challenge carries authority RESEARCH_AND_FALSIFICATION_ONLY and CHALLENGES_DO_NOT_AUTHORIZE_REPLACEMENT, so a counter-theory cannot promote itself.
buildRedQueenEvaluatorTournament. Five evaluator profiles ballot independently and disagreement is preserved rather than averaged; EVALUATOR_CONSENSUS_IS_INTERNAL_RANKING_NOT_EXTERNAL_PROOF.

entries.concept: Present Free Will Outranks the Model
entries.note: AUTHORITY_RUNGS is a frozen ordering with present conscious choice first; resolve decides by rank and never by evidence strength, so a prediction with a hundred corroborations still loses. deferralDrift counts the accumulation the canon warns about, and returns it to Mohamed rather than correcting for it.
